**Current flows — v0.1.0**
Entry -> first available item -> questions in original exam order; empty competitions -> message only; list failure -> manual Retry.
Select -> Answer -> pending -> confirmed and locked OR not confirmed (retain selection; safe retry without duplicate evaluation).
Page/competition change -> discard answers; page scroll resets. Exit -> discard. Desktop collapsed trigger stays visible; hover/focus adds feedback; phone opens overlay drawer; dismissal preserves context. The Ghost trigger stays visible on all input devices. Preserve context on collapse/expand. Portuguese and English interface. Technical validation remains.
